LanguageData.BRW_AttackTargetDesc: Send this animal at one pawn its master can see. The fight stops when the target is downed.
LanguageData.BRW_AttackTargetMasterDesc: Point trained animals at one pawn you can see. They stop when that pawn is downed.
LanguageData.BRW_AttackTargetCancelDesc: Call the animal off this target.
LanguageData.BRW_AttackTargetNotVisible: The master cannot see that pawn, or it is too far to point at.
LanguageData.BRW_AttackTargetMasterAway: The master is not on this map.
